title: Surviving Research Publication: A Guide for New Scholars
description: This handbook provides the hidden information needed to successfully navigate your first research publications. From the basics of a literature review, through ethics and the use of technology, this book is an essential guide for graduate students and early career researchers. Topics covered include: literature reviews, citations, literature searches, scholarly publishing, research impact measures, research ethics, copyright, authorship, plagiarism, document formatting, and digital accessibility.
subjects: Journalism, Media Studies & Communications - Technical Writing
authors: Lily Compton - Editor / Megan O'Donnell - Editor / Kristin Terrill - Author
